_title: DEGRADER-3 — specification of the missing covalent-ligandability reference (`STOP_NO_REFERENCE`), and what of it is reachable on the admitted PubMed/PMC route
_scope_ceiling: Nothing in this file is an EMC efficacy, safety, selectivity, therapeutic-window or clinical-readiness claim. RSA is geometric. A ligandability label, had one been found, would be a classification in one screen's cells with one probe at one concentration — not adduct formation by any specific molecule and not selectivity. There is no wet lab.

1_what_STOP_NO_REFERENCE_requires.verdict_text_verbatim: Primary measurement tables were read and NONE of Q92570 / P22736 / P43354 appears in them. That is a real and useful answer: the covalent axis has no known-answer set in the public data actually reachable, and `V17`'s failed positive control cannot be repaired from it. ⚠ Bounded to the sources listed — it is not a statement about every chemoproteomics dataset that exists.

the_quantity_and_its_units.how_R_is_produced_VERBATIM_from_PMC10510: Most included studies provide a metric of cysteine ligandability or putative druggability, which is generated by comparing relative labeling by equimolar iodoacetamide in the presence and absence of electrophilic compound
the_quantity_and_its_units.ligandable_cutoff_VERBATIM_from_PMC10510: All datasets included in our database relied on competition ratio cutoffs for what defines a cysteine as “ligandable.” Generally, cysteines were categorized as liganded if they had at least two ratios R ≥ 4 (hit fragments) and one ratio between 0.5 and 2 (control fragments).
the_quantity_and_its_units.cutoff_is_study_specific_VERBATIM_from_P: we observed manuscript-specific differences in either the ratio cutoff value or number of minimum unique hit fragments (1 or 2) required ... For example, Cao et al. implemented a slightly more permissive ratio cutoff of 3 to account for high-field asymmetric waveform ion mobility spectrometry (FAIMS)-induced ratio compression. By comparison, Vinogradova et al. implemented a more stringent ratio cutoff of 5.
the_quantity_and_its_units.secondary_reactivity_quantity_VERBATIM_f: Signal intensity differences between 100 and 10 μM treated proteomes are reflected by a ratio (R). Hyperreactive cysteines are defined as those with R values <2, indicating labeling events that are not concentration dependent.
the_quantity_and_its_units.where_the_per_cysteine_numbers_sit_VERBA: individual competition ratios are listed in the Ligandable table and individual reactivity ratios are listed in the Reactive tab[le]
the_quantity_and_its_units.⛔_units_note: R is a mass-spectrometry intensity ratio, dimensionless. It is NOT an affinity, NOT a rate constant, NOT a free energy, and it is not commensurable with an RSA.

1_what_STOP_NO_REFERENCE_requires.the_comparison_it_would_enable: A LABELLED KNOWN-ANSWER SET for instrument `V17` (the exposure criterion `C7`, EXPOSED_RSA = 0.25). With per-cysteine identified / hyperreactive / ligandable labels on NR4A-family LBD cysteines, the geometric criterion could be scored as a classifier — recovery rate, false-negative rate, and the threshold-free rank's AUC-like behaviour — against measured labels rather than against a single anecdotal positive control.

cannot_say_now: that V17 / C7 has any measured sensitivity or specificity — it has exactly ONE positive control (NR4A1 Cys551) and it FAILS it, so the instrument is discredited but not characterised
that C397's geometric dominance corresponds to any measured ligandability of C397
that the paralogue cysteines' low exposure corresponds to measured non-ligandability
could_say_with_the_reference: V17's measured recovery rate on n labelled family cysteines, with the false negative on C551 placed inside a rate instead of standing alone
whether C397 is covered at all by any public cysteine-chemoproteomics study — a coverage statement, which is publishable in either direction
if covered and labelled: whether the geometric ranking agrees with the measured label, which is the only route in this program to raising the covalent axis above 'geometry only'
what_the_manuscript_could_then_say_and_c.⛔_what_it_still_would_NOT_license: A REFERENCE_FOUND outcome establishes only that a known-answer set EXISTS. Roadmap §2.3's claim ceiling still applies: the instrument would have to be built and tested against it before any requirement rises. Nothing about efficacy, safety, selectivity in cells, degradation or a therapeutic window follows from a competition ratio.

3_admitted_route_PubMed_PMC_what_it_yiel.route: mcp__PubMed__* only. No direct HTTP, no curl, no proxy, no publisher or CDN fetch attempted.

OBTAINED.what: the aggregate's peer-reviewed article record and full open-access text
OBTAINED.title_verbatim: CysDB: a human cysteine database based on experimental quantitative chemoproteomics.
OBTAINED.what_it_supplies: THE DEFINITION AND UNITS of the missing quantity, and the ligandable cutoff, verbatim — section 1 above. This is a real gain: before this call the repository had the quantity named only as 'ligandability' with no retrieved definition.
OBTAINED.what_it_does_NOT_supply: any value for any NR4A cysteine. Full text retrieved = 56,984 chars; regex scan for NR4A|NR4A1|NR4A2|NR4A3|Q92570|P22736|P43354|'nuclear receptor' returned ZERO matches. ⛔ That is NOT a reading of absence from the DATABASE — a database paper's narrative does not enumerate its rows. It only establishes that the article text carries no such value.

OBTAINED.title_verbatim: Celastrol-Induced Nur77 Interaction with TRAF2 Alleviates Inflammation by Promoting Mitochondrial Ubiquitination and Autophagy.
OBTAINED.observation: full text retrieved; regex scan finds 0 occurrences of 'Cys<number>', 0 of 'C5xx', 0 of 'covalent'. The single '551' is an antibody catalogue number. The abstract says celastrol 'binds Nur77' with no residue.
OBTAINED.⚠_scope_of_that_observation: ONE article, and PMC full text excludes supplementary material. This does NOT establish that Cys551 lacks literature support. It is CONSISTENT WITH — and does not supersede — the caveat the repository already records: 'NR4A1's status as the NR-V04 covalent site is PROPOSED (Zhang et al. 2018), not structurally confirmed. The positive control therefore tests the criteria against a literature attribution, not against a solved covalent complex.'

3_admitted_route_PubMed_PMC_what_it_yiel.★_answer: PARTIAL, and the useful part is the smaller one. The DEFINITION, UNITS and CUTOFF of the missing reference ARE obtainable on the admitted route and are now recorded verbatim with a citable identifier. The VALUES — the only thing that would discharge STOP_NO_REFERENCE — are NOT obtainable on this route, because they live in supplementary spreadsheets and an interactive app, and PubMed/PMC serves neither.

4_what_would_actually_be_required_and_by.minimum_sufficient_read: the rows of the aggregate's `Ligandable` and `Identifiers` tables (or the two Nat Biotechnol 2020 supplementary tables S4/S7) filtered to Q92570 / P22736 / P43354, returning for each matched cysteine: the UniProtKBID_CYS# site, the identified / hyperreactive / ligandable flags, and the underlying competition ratio R with its study of origin and that study's own cutoff.
4_what_would_actually_be_required_and_by.sufficient_negative: the same read returning ZERO rows for all three accessions across all nine constituent studies. That is a REFERENCE-ABSENT result with a denominator, which is strictly stronger than today's STOP_NO_REFERENCE (bounded to 2 tables) and is itself publishable.

route_that_could_do_it.is_that_route_CLOSED: NO — not globally. It is closed TO THIS LANE, and the distinction matters.

route_that_could_do_it.what_is_NOT_a_blocker: cost — the dispatch is $0, no GPU, no paid API. The blocker is authority and lane scope, not money and not feasibility.
